item.title: Progressive City Prosecutors Form Coalition To Fight ICE Abuses

item.title: Neil Young Pulls Catalogue From Amazon And Gives It To Greenland
item.description: Neil Young is not fooling around when it comes to his disdain of Jeff Bezos and Amazon. In his post, he writes why he is doesn't use Amazon. Sterogum writes: In October, Neil Young pulled his catalog from Amazon Music and called for a boycott. "BUY LOCAL. BUY DIRECT. BEZOS SUPPORTS THIS GOVERNMENT. IT DOES NOT SUPPORT YOU OR ME," he wrote. Now, he's reasserting that stance on his website and announcing that he's gifting his entire catalog to Greenland amid Trump's threats to seize the territory.
